name: Arabic Hesham (موقظ الرياح)
author: Hesham Localization (Arabic Hesham)
description: Full Arabic translation and native font support by Hesham Localization. Replaces the game's 2D language pack (dialogue, UI strings, Arabic bitmap font) and the title screen. Right-to-left text, Arabic shaping and the Windfall pirate door riddle bypass are provided by the runtime. Requires restart.
